tex_content.html:
Lemma
[finite length of a chart-contained $C^1$ curve]

↗ def:dc-ch1-2-9

1. ch7:3.3If $\gamma :[a,b]\to N$ is a $C^1$ curve whose image lies in the source of a single chart of $N$, then its length $\ell (\gamma )$ is finite. Reading the length through the chart presents it as $\mathrm{ofReal}\big(\int _a^b\sqrt{\langle \gamma ',\gamma '\rangle }\big)$, a real number.
Proof

↗ def:dc-ch1-2-9 \sketch In a single chart the metric coefficients and the $C^1$ velocity are bounded on the compact parameter interval, so the coordinate length integral is finite.

□
